title: Critique: why would these mechanisms give rise to consciousness

statements.text: After every mechanism a neural theory proposes, one may still ask why it gives rise to consciousness. Neural theories, this one among them, risk being underconstrained and need further elaboration.

sources.quote: One general critique that can be exerted on neural theories of consciousness is that, after considering the mechanisms illustrated
current theories risk being underconstrained and will require further elaboration
